name: autobrr
title: autobrr
description: Watches the announce channels and feeds of torrent trackers and Usenet indexers and sends a release that matches your filters to the download client or to Sonarr and Radarr within seconds. Open it after deploying to make the admin account, then add an indexer, a download client and a filter.
auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
